ambient: The walls take up the sound of your coat and give it back closer.
Ahead, the gap you're aiming for resolves into the gap after it.
Something behind you settles, and the way you came is the way you came.
description: A way through, between two things, that you started into upright. It's still passable. It has been still passable for a while now, and each stretch of it's a stretch you could go back along, and you're going forward because the light is that way.
name: The Narrow Way

looks: Wide enough. It has been wide enough every time you have checked.
The light through it's daylight and it's on your face.
You could get a hand through, and then a shoulder, and you have done both before.
objects.name: the gap ahead

looks: Cold on both sides at once, which they weren't at the start.
Marked, at your height, along the whole length, by people going through.
They're the walls of a building you could name if you went up a level.
objects.name: the walls

weather: The pressed, close warmth of stone that has had a person against it.
